card.line: Pi-hahiroth was a camping place near Baal-zephon and Migdol on Israel's journey, and it is where they set out to cross the sea.

moments.title: Crossing the sea
moments.text: The people set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea into the wilderness. They traveled three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
